cues.text: A twenty-eight-year-old woman has no relevant past medical history.
Ulcerative colitis causes inflammation and ulcers of the colon and rectum, with pain and diarrhoea mixed with blood and mucus.
The main differential is Crohn's disease, which can occur anywhere from mouth to anus, with skip lesions.
Ulcerative colitis is limited to the colon, with continuous inflammation. So the best diagnosis is ulcerative colitis.
